risk: Entrant cannot grant rights over employer- or collaborator-owned work
mitigation: Chris Page explicit personal-resource and ownership assurance; source-specific notices; provenance review
residual_risk: Low for the declared scope; recheck if new third-party material enters
hard_gate: G0 cleared for build and publication

risk: Outside interest, prize or publicity conflicts with employment/secondment obligations
mitigation: Chris Page explicit no-outside-interest assurance; recheck prize tax publicity and current rules only at submission or acceptance
test_or_evidence: Assurance retained; submission-time confirmation still required
residual_risk: Low before submission; submission-time facts and acceptance choices may change
hard_gate: G0 cleared for build and publication

risk: Pre-existing assets are mistaken for judged post-start work
mitigation: Baseline commit, competition branch, post-start diff, dated ADR, demo of new WebMCP behaviour

risk: Data-derived or misleading tool descriptions influence the agent
mitigation: Exactly five code-authored static descriptions: three query tools and two transient presentation tools; no data-derived tool metadata; review lock
test_or_evidence: Snapshot test of all registrations and effect annotations

risk: Hostile source text is treated as instructions
mitigation: Untrusted-content annotation; compact structured fields; escape/render as text; malicious fixture tests

risk: Tool input captures unrelated conversation or personal context
mitigation: Closed schemas; bounded query record and claim-selection fields; no user context/history/URL/callback fields; visible warning

risk: Declared read-only tool performs hidden network/storage/action behaviour
mitigation: Three query tools are read-only; two presentation tools truthfully declare a reversible in-memory page effect. Same-origin static files; CSP; no storage or runtime external fetch; network interception tests
test_or_evidence: Browser trace static analysis and tool-effect parity tests

risk: Runtime fetch leaks query or context to external services
mitigation: No runtime external fetch; strict CSP and connect-src self; credentials omitted
test_or_evidence: Network log shows no third-party request

risk: Old record is presented without observation date or limitation
mitigation: Required observed date and visible source limitation; no silent refresh substitution
test_or_evidence: Observation-date presentation passes; a dedicated stale-threshold fixture remains pending
residual_risk: Medium until the stale-threshold policy and fixture are implemented

risk: Catalogue presence is mistaken for public API access
mitigation: Closed access statuses; default access-not-established; fixed disclaimer; evidence URL required for stronger states

risk: Missing or conflicting rights are displayed as open
mitigation: No default open licence; confirmed/missing/conflicting states; record-level notices
test_or_evidence: Missing-licence fixture passes; a dedicated conflicting-rights fixture remains pending
residual_risk: Low–Medium until the conflict fixture is implemented

risk: Record or source is substituted without detection
mitigation: Four exact authored source locks; raw-file SHA-256 verification; catalogue receipt Evidence Trace and federation bindings; fail closed
test_or_evidence: Digest mismatch source-substitution and source-lock admission tests

risk: Record contains javascript:, credentials, open redirect or misleading external target
mitigation: HTTP(S)-only parser; no credential URLs; allowlist/host label; rel=noopener; visible destination
test_or_evidence: Unsafe URL fixtures and link audit

risk: Agent-only feature or evidence cannot be understood by a disabled user
mitigation: Same execution functions; manual parity; WCAG 2.2 AA gates; keyboard reflow forced-colours and reduced-motion checks; screen-reader observation remains planned

risk: WebMCP draft or browser support changes before judging
mitigation: Feature detection; manual fallback; exact-host recordings; freeze compatible adapter
test_or_evidence: Installed Chrome and Microsoft Edge five-tool checks; supported live-host observation pending

risk: Live URL serves a different commit/build than the tested release
mitigation: Single-build promotion; exact commit in deployment metadata; downloaded Pages artefact and post-deploy digest comparison
test_or_evidence: PR #9; exact-main run 33286750188; Pages run 33286771963; all 20 live files matched the artefact
residual_risk: Low for the recorded deployment; future redeployment or availability can still change

risk: Independent site appears to be GOV.UK or employer-endorsed
mitigation: Own identity, font and colours; no Crown/GOV.UK logo; prominent disclaimer

risk: Official credential, unpublished material or personal data enters public repository/build
mitigation: Personal clean environment; secret scanning; generated file inventory; no private corpus
